thread:
maya: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem — we need to claim action items and lock owners. Recurring latency spikes (three in ~10 days) so priority is reliability + short-term rollback guardrails. I'll list proposed tickets below.

aj: I can claim the infra perf experiment (INF-3721). Will sketch the benchmark plan and schedule runs. ETA Mon.

sasha: I'll own runtime fallback logic changes (INF-3722). Plan: add circuit-breaker + configurable KV cache TTLs. Want canary in hosted first.

kevin: Clarify scope: do we need the fallback changes for Dedicated/Private at the same time? That affects rollout effort.

maya: Start hosted only for the code change. Dedicated/Private as follow-up tasks (INF-3723). We'll treat that as a separate deliverable under a parent epic.

aj: Noted. I'll post perf baselines to the postmortem doc. Also creating the infra runbook checklist for the oncall team.

oncall-bot: Incident pattern detected — spikes on 2026-02-10, 2026-02-15, 2026-02-20. Recurrence window 10 days. Recommend runbook audit and automated alert tuning.

maya: Good catch. Let's assign runbook audit to @tess (INF-3724). Tess, can you take a quick pass on alert thresholds + paging playbook?

tess: I can do the runbook audit. Will check alert flapping thresholds and add a remediation step to mute noise during known bursts. ETA Wed EOD.

maya: RACI for the top three items: R: @sasha (runtime changes), @aj (infra experiments), A: @maya, C: @kevin, I: @tess, @oncall-bot.

sasha: Agree. I'll open a PR draft and add detailed test matrix. Will include the fallback health metric we discussed.

aj: For INF-3721 I'll attach the perf script and sample output. Quick command to reproduce load locally:
```bash
./scripts/loadtest.sh --target staged-hosted --duration 5m --concurrency 50
```
I'll put results in the postmortem doc under "benchmarks".

kevin: For rollout plan, propose canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation windows. If error rate > 1% revert. Thoughts?

maya: Sounds good. Add rollback play in the PR checklist. Also creating a parent epic INF-3720 to track cross-cutting items and deadlines. I'll assign due dates: 2 weeks for runtime fix CANARY, 3 weeks for Dedicated follow-up.

tess: Adding a maintenance window proposal to the doc so paging load during rollout is predictable.

maya: Weekly sync: Wednesdays 10am PT. I'll create a recurring calendar and update the postmortem page with owners + JIRA links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3720 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3721 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3722 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3724

aj: :thumbsup: I'll comment on INF-3721 with the initial baseline by EOD Monday.

sasha: I'll aim for a PR by Tue and flag for review.

maya: Thanks all — I'll close the loop on the doc and ping when epics/tickets are created. :white_check_mark:
